title: Rodrixxz's PocketCraft
description: Optimized Minecraft modpack for Steam Deck & handheld PCs.
body:
# Rodrixxz's PocketCraft
![fabric](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2719ff362a548cc69cdf553fab34f5c4bec5b037.png)   [![support me](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c4c994ca06f3bc6bbcfdc5f6b98d4af42e397033.png)](https://ko-fi.com/rodrixxzlord)

This is a lightwweight and performance-focused Minecraft modpack designed specifically for handheld gaming PCs such as the Steam Deck or the ROG Ally.

The goal of this modpack is to provide a smooth and comfortable portable Minecraft experience without compromising stability or gameplay quality. PocketCraft focuses on performance optimization, controller usability, and interface improvements suited for smaller screens.

Unlike traditional modpacks that prioritize large content expansions, PocketCraft is carefully curated to ensure efficient resource usage and consistent frame rates on handheld hardware.

## Key Features
**Hadnheld-optimized performance**
The modpack includes modern performance improvements to ensure stable gameplay and high frame rates on portable devices.

**Controller-friendly gameplay**
PocketCraft is designed to work seamlessly with game controllers, allowing players to enjoy Minecraft comfortably without needing a keyboard and mouse.

**Interface improvements for small screens**
Various tweaks improve readability and usability on handheld displays.

**Vanilla-friendly experience**
PocketCraft preserves the core Minecraft gameplay while improving performance and accessibility.

## Target Devices
PocketCraft is built for handheld gaming PCs, including:
- Steam Deck
- ROG Ally
- Other portable Windows or Linux gaming devices.
## Design Philosophy
PocketCraft follows a simple philosophy: make Minecraft feel natural and smooth on handheld hardware. Every included mod serves a specific purpose, wheter improving performance, controller compatibility, or usability on portable screens.

The result is a clean and optimized Minecraft experience tailored for gaming on the go.
